name: Banyan Tree Lang Co
short_description: An 89-pool-villa beach resort at the Laguna Lang Co destination, roughly midway between Hue and Da Nang, with every villa built around its own private pool.
ai_summary: Banyan Tree Lang Co is an all-pool-villa resort of 89 villas at the Laguna Lang Co integrated destination, sited between the East Sea and the Truong Son mountains on a stretch of coast roughly 75 minutes from either Hue or Da Nang's airport. Villa categories range from beach-front to lagoon and panoramic villas, each with a private pool, and the resort has an 18-hole championship golf course, a Banyan Tree Spa, a watersports centre, and several restaurants on site. It has been recognised in Condé Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards and is a two-MICHELIN-Key property. Guest reviews consistently praise the villa design, personal butler service, and the resort's genuinely secluded setting, though that same remoteness means there's little beyond the resort itself within a half-hour drive, so most guests treat it as a self-contained stay rather than a base for exploring Hue or Da Nang.

faqs.question: How many villas does Banyan Tree Lang Co have?
faqs.answer: 89 all-pool villas spread across beach-front, lagoon, and panoramic categories, each built around its own private pool as part of the wider Laguna Lang Co integrated destination between Hue and Da Nang.

faqs.question: Is Banyan Tree Lang Co close to Hue or Da Nang?
faqs.answer: It's roughly 75 minutes by road from either city's airport, sitting on a stretch of coast between the two. Most guests treat it as a self-contained resort stay, visiting Hue's imperial sites or Da Nang/Hoi An as day trips.
